welcome.title: Welcome to WhisperSM
welcome.description: Dictate in any app with a single shortcut. Transcription and AI rewriting run on your computer, so nothing you say leaves it.

speech.title: Instant dictation

ai.title: AI modes
ai.text: Clean up, email, message, notes: rewrite your words with an on-device model.

privacy.title: 100% private
